title: AN ORDINANCE REGULATING TELECOMMUNICATIONS CABLE INSTALLATIONS, UNDERGROUND UTILITY DUCTS, AND RESTORATION OF PUBLIC ROADS IN DAVAO CITY
committee: Committee on Public Works and Telecommunications, Sangguniang Panlungsod

physical_specs.paper_size: Legal / Folio (8.5 x 13.0 inches / 215.9 x 330.2 mm)
physical_specs.margins: Top 1.0 in, Bottom 1.0 in, Left 1.5 in, Right 1.0 in
physical_specs.typography: 12pt Arial, 1.5 line spacing, formal section bold caps
physical_specs.enacting_clause: BE IT ORDAINED BY THE SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD OF DAVAO CITY, IN SESSION ASSEMBLED

sections.text: This Ordinance shall be cited as the 'Davao City Telecommunications Infrastructure and Underground Cabling Ordinance of 2026'.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: The City Government ensures public road safety, prevents aerial cable clutter, and coordinates telecommunications infrastructure pursuant to Republic Act No. 7925 and Republic Act No. 7160.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 7925 §4; Republic Act No. 7160 §458(a)(5)(vi)
sections.legal_rationale: Valid municipal police power over city roads and utilities.

sections.text: 'Public Telecommunications Entity' refers to any entity authorized to provide public telecommunications services. 'Excavation Permit' refers to an authorization to dig public streets.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: All telecommunications utilities undertaking street excavation for fiber optic installation must obtain an Excavation Permit from the City Engineer and post a performance restoration bond.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.legal_rationale: Direct municipal authority to regulate street digging and ensure road repair.

sections.sec_title: UNDERGROUND CABLING MANDATE IN HERITAGE ZONES
sections.text: All overhead aerial power and telecommunications cables within the designated downtown historical and commercial zones must be placed underground within three (3) years.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.legal_rationale: Valid local zoning and public safety measure.

sections.sec_title: LOCAL LEGISLATIVE FRANCHISE REQUIREMENT FOR WIRELESS CARRIERS
sections.text: No public telecommunications entity holding a national legislative franchise from the Congress of the Philippines shall transmit wireless cellular signals or operate frequency transmitters within Davao City without first obtaining a separate secondary legislative franchise approved by the Sangguniang Panlungsod.
sections.label: Contradiction
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 7925 §5; Republic Act No. 7925 §21; Presidential Decree No. 576-A §1
sections.legal_rationale: Directly contradicts Republic Act No. 7925 which vests exclusive regulatory authority over wireless frequencies and national telecommunications carriers in the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC). Confirmed in Batangas CATV v. CA (2004) under the preemption doctrine.

sections.sec_title: UNILATERAL RATE REGULATION OF INTERNET SERVICES
sections.text: The Sangguniang Panlungsod shall fix the maximum retail subscription tariffs that mobile telephone carriers may charge individual subscribers residing within Davao City.
sections.label: Contradiction
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 7925 §17; 1987 Constitution Art. XII §19
sections.legal_rationale: Directly violates Section 17 of Republic Act No. 7925, which reserves the regulation and deregulation of telecommunication tariffs exclusively to the NTC.

sections.text: Cellular operators are encouraged to utilize shared passive infrastructure and co-locate on authorized common cellular towers.
sections.label: Neutral
sections.legal_rationale: Parallels national DICT common tower policy.

sections.text: Excavated road trenches must be restored to original asphalt or concrete specifications within forty-eight (48) hours of cable laying.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: The City Telecommunications Infrastructure Coordinating Committee shall coordinate all scheduled road works to prevent duplicate street diggings.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: Unauthorized excavation or failure to restore roads shall be penalized by a fine of P5,000.00 and forfeiture of the restoration bond.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: Invalidity of any section shall not affect the remaining portions.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: All prior conflicting municipal measures are repealed.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: This Ordinance takes effect thirty (30) days from publication.
sections.label: Neutral
